title: Undo and Redo
drDigitalIntro:
Made a mistake? Undo it instantly — no retyping needed.
• Ctrl+Z (or Command+Z) undoes your last action. Press it again to undo more.
• Ctrl+Shift+Z (or Command+Shift+Z) redoes what you just undid. On Windows you can also use Ctrl+Y.
• Undo works in almost every app: word processors, email, photos, drawing tools.
• Common mistake: deleting a lot of text and panicking — just press Ctrl+Z a few times to bring it back.
• You can undo many steps back, not just the very last one.
drDigitalSuccess: Remember: Ctrl+Z is your safety net. Made a mess? Undo it!
drDigitalHint: Just read along and click Continue when ready.
